The STP260N6F6 is an N-channel power MOSFET manufactured by STMicroelectronics.

Key Specifications

• Type: N-Channel Power MOSFET (STripFET™ VI DeepGATE™ series)
• Drain-Source Voltage (\(V_{DSS}\)): 60 V
• Continuous Drain Current (\(I_{D}\)): 120 A (at \(T_C = 25^\circ\text{C}\))
• Drain-Source On-Resistance (\(R_{DS(on)}\)): ≈ 3 mΩ (Max at \(V_{GS} = 10\text{V}\))
• Gate Charge (\(Q_{g}\)): 183 nC (max)
• Power Dissipation (\(P_{D}\)): 300 W (\(T_C = 25^\circ\text{C}\))
• Operating Temperature Range: -55°C to +175°C
• Package: 3-Pin TO-220 (Through-hole)

Common Applications

• High-current switching applications
• DC-DC converters and power supplies
• Motor control and synchronous rectification
